description: BITZER Gascooler Tool rates released R744 gas-cooler models, selects models for a required capacity, retrieves validated R744 saturation limits, and creates localized PDF, STEP, 3D, dimensional-drawing, pinch-diagram, and capacity-map artifacts in SI units. Compatible ChatGPT clients receive one inline multilingual result gallery with calculation inputs and outputs, PNG previews, an interactive 3D model, warnings, the mandatory tentative-data notice, expiry status, and secure temporary downloads. The app never substitutes estimated engineering values when calculation data, traces, released geometry, or rendering dependencies are unavailable.

defaultPrompt: Select a CO2 gas cooler for 180 kW CO2 inlet 95 °C and 9000 kPa(a) leaving at 35°C, water entering at 20 °C and leaving at 35°C.
